/our-story.title: Goutu Restaurant
/our-story.description: Handcrafted burgers, local ingredients, zero shortcuts. Dine-in at Oak Street, Brooklyn. Open Tuesday through Sunday.
p: A neighborhood spot born from a backyard grill and a love for good food.
Goutu started the way most good things do — with a craving and no decent option nearby.
In 2019, childhood friends Marco and Diane set up a pop-up grill in Marco's backyard, invited the block, and sold out in two hours.
They didn't plan to open a restaurant. They just wanted a really good burger.

Two years later, they signed a lease on Oak Street and opened Goutu — named after the French word for 'tasty', a nod to Diane's family roots and a promise to every customer that walked through the door.
Every patty is still hand-smashed to order. Every sauce is still made in-house. Nothing has changed except the kitchen is slightly bigger.
"We didn't open Goutu to be a chain. We opened it to be your place."
First backyard pop-up. Sold out in 2 hours.
Won "Best Burger" at the Brooklyn Street Food Festival
Oak Street location opens. 40 seats, one fryer, endless energy.
First full menu launch. The Smash Classic becomes a neighborhood institution.
Added the back patio. Summer nights are now something else entirely.
Still your corner spot. Still no shortcuts.
We source from local farms and grind our own beef daily. If we wouldn't eat it, it doesn't go on the menu.
This restaurant exists because the neighborhood showed up. We've never forgotten that.
Great ingredients don't need to be hidden. Every recipe has a clear reason to exist.

h2: Born in a Backyard, Built for the Block.
p: Handcrafted patties, local ingredients, zero shortcuts. Come hungry, leave happy.
We're open almost every day — come as you are, no dress code required.
For groups of 10 or more, please call us directly — we'll make sure everything is ready for you.
For reservations under 10, use our online booking system.
We're proud of what our regulars say. But don't just take our word for it — see for yourself.
"I've tried every burger joint in the neighborhood. Goutu isn't even a competition anymore — it's just the answer."
"The Smash Classic on a Friday night with friends. That's my therapy."
"Best onion rings on the East Coast. I will not be taking questions."
"They know my order by heart now. That tells you everything."
"Worth every minute of the queue. And yes, there's sometimes a queue."

Goutu started with one grill, two friends, and a stubborn belief that a great burger could change someone's day. A few years and a thousand patties later, we're still at it — right here in the neighborhood.
Yes, we did eat this after.
